source_of_truth: README.tr.md 'Doğrulama' table for the legacy ids; this file for iteration-21
note: Iteration-21 live regression set (Claude + OpenCode Go). The goldens are derived from SKILL.md's rules, NOT yet confirmed by cold agents — run them with fresh agents and grade with grade_routing.py. `golden_output` is the output the rules should produce; `python grade_routing.py --selftest --results-dir /tmp/x` proves the grader and the goldens agree. The iteration-20 (Codex) set is archived under archive/iteration-20-codex/routing/.
